name: Co-processing of bio-feeds in FCC and hydrotreaters
applications: partly renewable diesel, jet and gasoline in existing units
principle: Bio-feeds such as vegetable oils, animal fats, used cooking oil or biomass pyrolysis oil are blended into the fossil feed of an existing hydrotreater, hydrocracker or FCC. Small shares need only catalyst changes; larger shares need unit modifications for extra hydrogen, heat release, CO/CO2 and water.

process_steps.name: FCC unit
equipment: existing riser with dedicated feed nozzles

performance.basis: Honeywell UOP: under 5% with catalyst change, 5-10% with minor modification, 10-20% with revamp

performance.metric: biogenic feed rate in an FCC case study

advantages: Uses existing units with low capital
limitations: Renewable share limited by unit and fuel specifications
Extra hydrogen use and CO/CO2 formation

sources.note: Topsoe and Preem achieve 85% co-processing, May 2021
